narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On January 30, 2024, at approximately 0915 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at the Washtenaw County Jail in Ann Arbor, Michigan, after his arrest by local police for retail fraud. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico. He declined to answer questions about his immigration history.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
Records reflect a final order of removal entered against the subject by the Newark Immigration Court on 11/18/2013. No record of the order's execution, and no record of the subject's departure, was located; agents could not determine whether he left the United States after the order.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is being presented for prosecution under 8 U.S.C. 1326 as an alien found in the United States after removal.
DISPOSITION:
An immigration detainer was lodged and the case was referred for review of the prior order.
